data.grouping_limit: Three repeated episodes from one chemistry; CV is within-chemistry episode generalization, not heldout chemistry.
data.inner_group_key: separate diagnostic episode_id, not a relabelled chemical split

development.event_metrics: Only after exact original RPC outcome linkage is reconstructed; no independent-sample claim from correlated rows.
metrics: fixed.6 crossings and real supported control availability (descriptive only)
development.negative_result_retention: Retain full/internal worse than control, selectedstep0, T at bound, no.6crossings and all fit failures; do not select another seed or change a threshold.
roles: report raw predictions on all83 original dev rows
fit the unchanged positive temperature using original bounded NLL(-4,4)

execution_runner_status: Not implemented or authorized to train by this proposal; this builder only fixes scope and deterministic selection rules.

fitting.duration_unit: optimizer updates, because train folds fit<256 rows while final all293 requires two minibatches per epoch
fitting.feature_name_contract: Use the predefined original feature-name schema; no labels or dev-only feature selection.
fitting.final_fit: Fresh original seeded initialization on all293 train rows, precisely the selected update count; no dev early stopping.
fitting.fold_preprocessing: Refit all preprocessing/prototypes on the two fitting episodes; never reuse globally fitted medians/scales/prototypes inside folds.
fitting.hyperparameters: Read and bind original checkpoint config byte-for-byte before execution; do not silently use defaults.
fitting.only_candidate_change: Choose training duration on grouped training episodes instead of raw original-dev BCE; dev remains unused until the checkpoint is fixed.
fitting.records: Actual every-update loss/state hash/parameter delta, step0 and candidate-step states, row+episode provenance, all fold curves and failures.
fitting.selection: Minimum mean heldout-episode uncalibrated BCE across all3 training folds; earliest/fewest-step tie. Select independently for each predeclared feature condition; do not choose a model by dev/test outcomes.

fixed_learned_models.raw_feature_names: Exact original scalar schema,298 raw features

fixed_learned_models.limit: Same hidden widths, but fewer inputs/parameters; this is a predictive control, not a capacity-matched causal feature intervention.

fresh_dev_followup_requires_new_registra.comparison: Same support-aware theta0/typed heads/TC/evaluator, original scalar vs selected new scalar
fresh_dev_followup_requires_new_registra.full_method_next: Only after a separately reviewed decision: fresh full-parameter ES fromtheta0 and independent evaluation. Do not rename currentG2; include an explicitly budgeted same-controllerG0 dev selection reference.
fresh_dev_followup_requires_new_registra.primary_readout: All paired AUDC deltas and real NN-vs-schema action footprints, with small-n uncertainty; no best-seed selection.
fresh_dev_followup_requires_new_registra.typed_primary_binding: New explicit combined-model provenance is required: original typed tensor bytes remain unchanged, but old typed primary-checkpoint binding cannot be forged.

gate_before_any_controller_claim.condition: Full internal predictor must show reproducible train-fold learning beyond untrained/constant controls and separately reported dev discrimination/proper scoring; in-sample calibrated dev metrics alone do not certify controller benefit.
gate_before_any_controller_claim.if_no_signal: Stop predictive-improvement claim and record negative/insufficient evidence; never force score range.
gate_before_any_controller_claim.not_a_claim_of_significance: Only3 correlated train episodes/one dev chemistry; no large-sample claim.

purpose: Test train-only model selection before declaring scalar internal features useful; separate it from development calibration and fixed-threshold control.
